title: skills: objectstack-i18n names GET /api/v1/i18n/locales but not the sourceLocale member PR #36858 adds to its answer
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhpykmQZe1yMupC2CU

Carries the `skills/**` half of #36504's `Skills-docs:` debt. #36504 / PR #36858 keeps the schema, the producer and the console. The seat filed this from the dev's report (#36504 comment 7123427766). Not claimed.

## What happens

PR #36858 gives the answer of `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales` (`GetLocalesResponseSchema`, `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) one optional member, `sourceLocale: string`. It holds the declared `i18n.sourceLocale`, or the default locale when none is declared (`Metadata-protocol: added`). Before this, a client could read only `isDefault`. Now it can tell which language inline `label:` text is written in without reading the stack config.

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:387` (origin/main 5c2e34cdb) names the route (`GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`, `/translations/:locale` and `/labels/:object/:locale`) and says nothing about what it answers.
- `:44` teaches `sourceLocale` as a config key read only by tooling (`os lint`, `os i18n check`, `os i18n extract`).
- So an agent that builds a client which must write translations in the right language (the case #36504 fixes in the console) gets no pointer that the server now serves the source locale.

Re-check: `git grep -n "i18n/locales" -- skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` (expect the one hit above).

## To do

1. Say in one clause, at `:387` or beside the `:44` row, that the locales answer marks the default locale (`isDefault`) and names `sourceLocale` (the declared one, else the default).
2. Keep the skill's line budget: replace words, do not add a paragraph.

## Order

After PR #36858 merges. Until then the skill is still true of `main`.

Blocked-by: #36504

## Grade

Suggested-grade: p2 · the published skill leaves out a served member that tells a client which language its translation writes target. area:ux · Documentation. `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H). The domain is triage's to set.
